additional_info.subject: 0442333 - ID0442333/DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370002]Logs check CRM:00314000212
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Luigi,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0442333.
The ticket is opened for charging issues on 05.08.2025 on charger
Y2/S1 313508370002
in Pontecagnano.
Here are the results of my logs analysis:
At 2025-08-05T23:10:01. the session is authorized on DC1
At 2025-08-05T23:10:14 DC1 is plugged in and enters in P01_Authentication phase at 2025-08-05T23:10:20.
Session fails at 2025-08-05T23:11:17 with EcoG error 38:
EcoG error 38 says that "V2G - message processing (e.g invalid param, wrong internal state) V2G09MSGSequence_V2G09Session_V2G09Authorization". The V2G09Authorization parameter exchanged by the EV with the charger was invalid.
At 2025-08-05T23:14:00 the DC1 plug is disconnected from the EV, and at 2025-08-05T23:16:57 DC2 is connected to the EV.
The session fails immediately with EcoG error 54 ""ERR_EVCOM, EV communication problem detected"
At 2025-08-05T23:23:03 DC2 is connected again. this time, the session stops as per request form the EV.
After this, no further sessions are attempted.
From my analysis it looks like the issue stands in the EV, unable to properly communicate with the charger. If this type of issues appear, a reboot of the charger will not probably solve the issue, but it would be required a restart of the EV instead.
Since the sessions analyzed indicated a vehicle communication problem, I will proceed to close the ticket if no further clarification is required.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon.
With kind regards,

Hello Luigi,
As per a reboot of the charger restarts our SECC, also a restart of the EV should normally power-cycle and restart the EVCC.
Usually it is enough to switch off the EV for a few second and then switch it back on.
